description: Grouped Go minor/patch and GitHub Actions updates with pinned action digests; github.com/werf/nelm follows nelm's trdl STABLE channel (not the Go proxy's latest, which is effectively alpha), k8s.io/* move only in lockstep with nelm, custom-manager go.mod bumps run `go mod tidy` (postUpgradeTasks require a self-hosted Renovate), and the `# renovate:`-annotated *_VERSION tool pins in the workflows (golangci-lint, govulncheck, tfplugindocs) are bumped too.

customManagers.description: Bump github.com/werf/nelm in go.mod to whatever version nelm's STABLE trdl channel points to

packageRules.description: Routine Go minor/patch bumps arrive as one grouped PR
GitHub Actions updates grouped; digests pinned by the preset above
gomod manager must NOT touch nelm (the proxy's latest is the alpha channel; the custom manager above owns it) nor the k8s.io modules (transitively pinned by nelm, lockstep-only)
A stable-channel nelm bump edits go.mod outside the gomod artifact updater, so regenerate go.sum; the PR still needs a human semantic review against docs/guides/known-limitations.md — never automerge
